line.commit: git commit, 7 to 40 lowercase hex; null only outside a git checkout
line.out_sha256: files the step wrote: relative name -> SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex), names sorted
line.prev: SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex) of the previous line's UTF-8 text without its newline
line.format: JSON.stringify of the keys in this order, one line, ending with a newline

kinds: manifest.json kind; doctor, smoke, headstart, live_from and live_sim records have no step order
repeat: a confirmatory step may be written again right after itself (a re-run), except the steps in once

exploratory.rule: exploratory lines stand only after the confirmatory stage_b and do not advance the order; after it every stage_a and stage_b line, and every verdict line once the confirmatory verdict is written, has exploratory true; the confirmatory verdict follows the confirmatory stage_b with only notes and exploratory lines between (normally none: both come from one run) and lists the same verdict.json hash as stage_b

outputs: every step line lists at least one file in out_sha256; a confirmatory line also lists every file that required_outputs names for its step

batch.rule: across the ledgers of all numbers sessions and the space-bar block: no confirmatory step of after_last_record has a utc before the latest record line of any of them, and every ledger holds each step of before_first_reveal at or before the first reveal line of any of them; once a step of after_last_record is written, the batch holds a numbers session and the space-bar block, each with a record line (the block may be missing only when it was cut, spec 14.4)

note.rule: note lines may stand anywhere and do not advance the order; what is a snake_case word, detail an optional string
